claims.claim: `deploy/termux/services/aios-node/run` is an executable native-Termux runit run file with mode 100755 and LF line endings that uses `exec` to start exactly one `aios-node host` process with no internal restart, sleep, or polling loop.

The adapter exposes deterministic environment-overridable paths for the AIOS-node executable, host-state directory, pinned AIOS-renew executable, and Antigravity executable with Mi 10 Pro defaults, and passes the latter two only as bounded readiness configuration to the host CLI.

Static contract tests in `tests/test_termux_service.py` prove the service adapter contains no direct Executor invocation, canonical AIOS operation, Git mutation, project verification, network/model call, wake lock, service enable/disable action, or autonomous retry mechanism.

`docs/N4-TERMUX-RUNIT-ADAPTER.md` documents the exact deployment destination under `$PREFIX/var/service/aios-node`, the configuration boundary, the NODE-003 activation step, and the explicit rule that runit supervises only host availability rather than engineering execution and cannot restart canonical AIOS work.

The existing NODE-001 test suite remains green and new standard-library tests validate the Termux adapter contract deterministically on non-Termux development hosts without invoking shell scripts, models, network calls, AIOS, or Executors.
